request.style: English, Female solo voice, emotional and folk-like, with choir backing, bodhran, fiddle, flute, acoustic guitar, gentle harp, hopeful and celebratory mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion
We were like those who dream
Mouths filled with laughter
Tongues with shouts of joy

[Chorus]
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad

[Verse]
Then it was said among the nations
The Lord has done great things for them
Restore our fortunes, O Lord
Like streams in the desert

[Chorus]
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad

[Bridge]
Those who sow in tears
Will reap with shouts of joy
Whoever goes out weeping
Carrying seed to sow

[Outro]
Will come home with shouts of joy
Carrying the sheaves
The Lord has done great things for us
And we are glad
